# First Deploy: full details

> First Deploy is an after-hours phone desk and live apps for field-service businesses, built by AgentHive Inc in Palm Coast, Florida. Setup is $1,750: start with 50% ($875) and pay the balance at completion, or pay in full. The desk is $250/month, starting at go-live (invoiced separately). One leak goes live this week on a written plan.

## Business
- Name: First Deploy, a product of AgentHive Inc (AGENTHIVEINCCOM LLC)
- Location: Palm Coast, FL (Flagler County), United States
- Service area: Florida statewide, focused on these counties:
  - Flagler (Palm Coast, Bunnell, Flagler Beach)
  - Volusia (Daytona Beach, Ormond Beach, DeLand, Port Orange)
  - St. Johns (St. Augustine)
  - Duval (Jacksonville)
  - Orange (Orlando)
  
  Setup is done remotely, so businesses anywhere in the US can use it.
- Trades served: HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, pest control, landscaping. Also auto and truck repair shops.
- Phone: +1 320-335-6186
- Email: daniel@agenthiveinc.com
- Booking: https://calendly.com/coltsinsider/30min (free 30-minute call)
- Web: https://firstdeploy.ai

## Service: after-hours desk
- What it is: a voice line that picks up the calls a business misses after hours. It takes the caller's details, books the job and sends the follow-up text.
- Who it is for: HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, pest control and landscaping businesses that get calls at night or on weekends.
- How it starts: we pick one leak (for example missed night calls), write the plan and put it live this week.
- Price: part of the $1,750 setup. After that, $250/month per company from go-live.

## Service: live apps
- What it is: the tools the crew and office open every day, such as estimates, booking and follow-up texts, and job records (photos and timestamps via JobProof).
- How it works: built beside the desk, on the same written plan, and left running.
- Price: included in the setup and the $250/month desk.

## Service: consult
- What it is: time with the operator (Daniel Graham) to look at a workflow and decide what to build.
- Price: the first 30 minutes are free (a qualifier). After that it's $75 / 30 min, $150 / hour, or a 10-hour pack at $1,250 with $625 up front.
- Book: https://calendly.com/coltsinsider/30min or https://firstdeploy.ai/consult

## Pricing
- Setup: $1,750 one-time.
  - Option 1: 50% to start ($875 deposit), balance at completion.
  - Option 2: pay in full, $1,750.
- Desk: $250/month per company, starting at go-live, invoiced separately. Cancel any time. When the month is turned off, the line goes dark.
- Projects scoped at 90 days are billed half up front and half at completion.
- Payments run through Stripe. A signed scope or the Stripe checkout takes precedence over the website.

## FAQ
**Where are you located?**
Palm Coast, Florida, in Flagler County.

**Which areas do you serve?**
All of Florida, with a focus on Flagler, Volusia, St. Johns, Duval and Orange counties and the Jacksonville, Daytona Beach and Orlando metros. Setup is remote, so businesses anywhere in the US can use it.

**Which trades do you work with?**
HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, pest control and landscaping, plus auto and truck repair shops.

**How much does it cost?**
$1,750 setup. You can start with 50% ($875) and pay the balance at completion, or pay in full. Then $250/month for the desk, starting at go-live.

**When does the $250/month start?**
At go-live. It is invoiced separately from the setup.

**How long does setup take?**
One leak goes live this week, on a written plan we agree on first.

**Can I cancel the monthly desk?**
Yes, at any time. When the month is turned off, the line goes dark.

**Do you need to visit in person?**
No. Setup is done remotely.

**What results can I expect?**
We build and run the workflow we write down together. We do not promise a third-party platform result, a search ranking or a revenue number.
